description: lexer.rs fallback formats 'other as char' (one byte of a multi-byte character); diag/render.rs expand_tabs pushes each byte as a char and counts a column per byte; SourceMap::locate's column is a byte count. Any diagnostic on a line containing a non-ASCII character prints a mangled snippet with a misplaced underline. Wanted: the unexpected-character error names the whole character with a span ending on a character boundary; snippet, underline and column are character based. Removes the 'v1 = byte count' caveat in source_map.rs. Signal: diagnostic fixtures (bad non-ASCII character; an error after a non-ASCII string on the same line).
title: A diagnostic names and underlines whole characters
